description: The owner's recurring standing rules and the guard that fails when a change breaks each one. A rule the owner states twice becomes a guard in the change that fixes it, and a row here. scripts/owner-rules.test.ts fails when a row names a guard script or test that does not exist, a guard that lint:guards does not chain, an allowlist that does not exist, or scans that differ from the guard's own. A rule with no guard yet carries the reason in unguardedReason.

rules.rule: Never separate pieces of copy with a middle dot (U+00B7), and never with a comma either.
The sidebar draws no section headings: the sections are named for a screen reader and drawn with no header.
rules.source: Owner review of the live app, 2026-11-19 (chef-sdlc-architecture-review-2026-11-19-corrections.md, section 2)

rules.rule: Light mode is not heavy: no shadow token heavier than the agreed light shadow. Dark mode has no bright shadows: a shadow is black in both themes and never drawn from text, ink or white.
rules.source: Owner review of the live app, 2026-11-19 (COR-2441; chef-sdlc-architecture-review-2026-11-19-corrections.md, section 2)

rules.rule: The interface never shows a file path, a ULID or a secret reference.
rules.source: Owner review of the live app, 2026-11-19 (chef-sdlc-architecture-review-2026-11-19-corrections.md, sections 1 and 2)

rules.rule: Every empty state is Cinder's EmptyState in its one layout: no hand-rolled empty-state markup and no layout, size or align variant.
rules.source: Owner review of the live app, 2026-11-19, six different empty-state patterns (chef-sdlc-architecture-review-2026-11-19-corrections.md, sections 1 and 2)

rules.rule: A term and value list is Cinder's DescriptionList, Inspector or KeyFacts, which put each pair on one line: no raw dl element.
rules.source: Owner review of the live app, 2026-11-25, label and value pairs drawn as two lines each (COR-2693)

rules.rule: A button or confirm whose label starts with a destructive verb (Delete, Remove, Terminate, Destroy, Purge, Revoke, Drop, Wipe) renders the danger treatment: a Button is danger or ghost-danger, never soft-danger, and an InlineConfirm or ConfirmDialog is destructive.
rules.source: Owner live review, 2026-11-25, item 23: an accent-coloured destructive action, then a soft-danger face that read lighter than its secondary

rules.rule: A status word is a badge, not plain text.
rules.source: Owner review of the live app, 2026-11-19 (chef-sdlc-architecture-review-2026-11-19-corrections.md, section 2)
rules.unguardedReason: Which words are statuses is a judgment no text scan can make exactly, and the corrections list no guard for it; the design reviewer checks it as a standing rule until a Cinder component carries it.
